resolution_report.speaker: lucan
resolution_report.text: We found him. The caretakers have him now.

resolution_report.speaker: mira
resolution_report.text: He needs to rest first. We dressed the leg, but he should not be walking on it.

resolution_report.speaker: regent_clerk
resolution_report.text: That accounts for everyone on the list. The man who reached Eldenmere is still with Mother Serene?

resolution_report.speaker: caelan
resolution_report.text: Yes. Tomas and your driver stayed to help her.

resolution_report.speaker: caelan
resolution_report.text: There is a break in the floor inside the chamber.

resolution_report.speaker: lucan
resolution_report.text: The worker said the creature came through it.

resolution_report.speaker: aldric
resolution_report.text: Their treatment and the journey home are my responsibility. The crew stays out of the cave.

resolution_report.speaker: lucan
resolution_report.text: There are still creatures in the passages.

resolution_report.speaker: aldric
resolution_report.text: Then the caretakers keep control of the entrance. Mother Serene is waiting for our account. We should return.

resolution_reunion.speaker: caelan
resolution_reunion.text: We did. He is with the caretakers.

resolution_reunion.speaker: mira
resolution_reunion.text: He is resting. His leg needs looking after.

resolution_reunion.speaker: regent_driver
resolution_reunion.text: This one has been trying to get up since you left.

resolution_reunion.speaker: serene
resolution_reunion.text: And he can stay where he is a little longer. Come in, all of you.

resolution_reunion.speaker: serene
resolution_reunion.text: He is stable. He needs rest; I will check him again before evening.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: serene
resolution_reckoning.text: You told me you had come to discuss the reserve.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: serene
resolution_reckoning.text: With your men already claiming it for the Crown.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: serene
resolution_reckoning.text: You also said the orders came from Her Majesty.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: aldric
resolution_reckoning.text: They did. Coming here as though nothing had already been decided was my choice.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: serene
resolution_reckoning.text: You let me speak without knowing what you had done.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: aldric
resolution_reckoning.text: Every community I visited asked when the next load would come. I thought a nearer supply would let us answer them.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: serene
resolution_reckoning.text: You could have brought that need to us honestly.

resolution_reckoning.speaker: aldric
resolution_reckoning.text: I should have. The men have withdrawn from the work. Their care and transport are on my account.

resolution_relief.speaker: serene
resolution_relief.text: We can help with food while the injured recover. The caretakers will tell us what else they need.

resolution_relief.speaker: mira
resolution_relief.text: Another source will not help much if the carts cannot reach it. We need to know which routes can actually take a load.

resolution_relief.speaker: aldric
resolution_relief.text: I can have the repair reports brought together.

resolution_relief.speaker: serene
resolution_relief.text: And I will put our account in writing. A request for proper joint review, with the public site records and the account of what happened to your crew.

resolution_relief.speaker: aldric
resolution_relief.text: I will send it with my report.

resolution_relief.speaker: serene
resolution_relief.text: This does not give permission to open the ground.

resolution_relief.speaker: aldric
resolution_relief.text: I understand. We still have work to do.

resolution_relief.speaker: aldric
resolution_relief.text: Thank you for bringing them back. I will see you at the festival.

resolution_companions.speaker: lucan
resolution_companions.text: Clean the grit out of those fittings before you put the blade away.

resolution_companions.speaker: lucan
resolution_companions.text: You kept your head in there.

resolution_companions.speaker: caelan
resolution_companions.text: About what I said in the cave—

resolution_companions.speaker: mira
resolution_companions.text: You do not have to explain.

resolution_companions.speaker: caelan
resolution_companions.text: I thought I might feel something.

resolution_companions.speaker: caelan
resolution_companions.text: I am glad we found him.

resolution_companions.speaker: mira
resolution_companions.text: Me too. I should get back to the workshop. Come and see me when you have a moment.

resolution_family.speaker: caelan
resolution_family.text: You told me to stay out of the cave.

resolution_family.speaker: serene
resolution_family.text: I did. Tell me why you went.

resolution_family.speaker: caelan
resolution_family.text: We could hear him. Lucan was with us, and Mira thought we could reach him.

resolution_family.speaker: serene
resolution_family.text: I am glad you brought him back.

resolution_family.speaker: serene
resolution_family.text: I am glad you came back too.

resolution_family.speaker: caelan
resolution_family.text: Aldric helped us. And he still did all of this without telling you.

resolution_family.speaker: caelan
resolution_family.text: I do not know what to make of him.

resolution_family.speaker: serene
resolution_family.text: You do not have to decide everything about him today.

resolution_family.speaker: tomas
resolution_family.text: When you are finished, can you come and look at the lanterns?

resolution_family.speaker: tomas
resolution_family.text: Nothing. I want to show you.

resolution_family.speaker: serene
resolution_family.text: Go and find him when you are ready. I have that request to write.
